props.name: LampPost
props.pivot: base centre; the model's pivot is the origin and the base sits at y = 0
props.collision_note: Pole only: Box is the cheapest collider and the claw top is no wider than the base, so the box is close to the real shape.
props.provenance: created by jg_57565 via Studio generate_mesh, pilot TASK-0125 (revision 1, candidate C, picked by jg 2026-11-02)
props.prompt: Chunky low-poly fantasy lamp post pole only, no globe: dark wrought-iron pole with a flared bell-shaped base, a twisted mid section, and a four-pronged claw holder at the top that can hold a glowing ball. Dark metal, simple readable shapes, game-ready.

globe.note: Pole top (5.0588) + 1 stud: the 2-stud Globe sits in the claw. Colour is tuned for Neon + Bloom 1.0: #FFB547 (and anything with green >= 130) renders lemon yellow, #FA7D12 reads amber. The PointLight stays #FFB547.

props.name: ModeArch
props.pivot: base centre; the model's pivot is the origin and the base sits at y = 0. The opening faces local Z; the generator yaws it onto the path axis.

light.note: colour comes from the placement (the arch colour); one light per arch, at the mesh centre inside the opening

props.collision_note: The mesh itself is CanCollide false (a hull would fill the opening and block the pad). The generator adds two transparent leg colliders per arch.
props.provenance: created by jg_57565 via Studio generate_mesh, TASK-0127 (candidate A, picked by jg 2026-11-02; maxTriangles 300, untextured)
props.prompt: Chunky low-poly rounded gateway arch, hollow centre you can walk through, two thick square legs joined by a semicircular top, simple readable shapes, plain untextured single-colour surface.
